title: Cass County board approves 12-month moratorium on data center permits
summary: The Cass County Board of Commissioners approved a 12-month pause on data center permits at a public hearing. Proposed data center regulations were tabled until September 22.

verbatims: The board voted 5-0 to approve a 12-month moratorium on permits for data centers.
notes: KLKN dateline August 11, 2026 and the article describe the hearing as this morning. Verbatim probed HIT.

title: Leavenworth County commission fails to extend 90-day data center moratorium; pause lapses
summary: The county commission voted 3-2 against extending its 90-day pause on data center applications, which then expired. Planning commissioners were reviewing data center regulation language.
source_title: Tonganoxie Mirror — Leavenworth County commission lifts moratorium on data center by 3-2 vote
verbatims: voted against the measure and it failed, 3-2
notes: Headline says the commission 'lifts' the moratorium but the body describes a failed extension motion; the record follows the body. Vote is Wednesday Aug 5 per article. Original 90-day enactment date (about May 2026 per a KCUR summary) not verified here, so no enactment date is stated. Conflicting KCUR (Aug 14) report also cited; not probed.

title: Sedgwick County extends data center moratorium for a third time, to December
summary: The county commission unanimously extended its data center moratorium a third time, to late December, saying the Planning Commission had not delivered enough regulations in time.
source_title: Fox Kansas — Data center proposals put on hold as Sedgwick County delays rules until late December
verbatims: A unanimous county commission vote extends a moratorium on data centers for the third time.
notes: event_date is the article date (Thursday Sept 3, 2026); the vote date is not stated but the prior pause expired Sept 11. The article gives two end dates (Dec 11 and Dec 24) that conflict; the record should not pick one until the county minutes are checked. Not verified against a second outlet.
